_doc: Stream E (M2). Quests for zone 'millbrook' (Millbrook Vale). Format: data/quests/README.md. Rewards: xp = share of a level's XP at the quest level, gold = multiple of a kill's gold; item.tier rolls at your level. `killRare` {zone, slot} names the zone's rare by slot (data/provinces/rares.json). Story-chain quests carry `story: n` (data/quests/province.json).

reeve_garrick.name: Reeve Garrick Pike
reeve_garrick.greeting: Three mills, one river, endless arguments about whose water it is.

goodwife_edda.name: Goodwife Edda
goodwife_edda.greeting: If you've come about the boar, get in line behind the boar.

castellan_oswy.name: Castellan Oswy
castellan_oswy.greeting: The keep is very secure. Mostly against us getting out.

tinker_cadoc.name: Cadoc the tinker
tinker_cadoc.greeting: Pots mended, knives sharpened, carts un-overturned. Usually.

quests.name: Millbrook Wheels
quests.offer: Halsbridge says you clear roads. Ours is blocked by boars who think it's theirs. It's a strong argument, they're very big.
quests.done: The carts roll again. Off you go to Ashcombe, they've a ruin that needs looking at.

quests.name: Moth-Eaten
quests.offer: Carrion moths in the grain loft. They don't eat grain. They eat whatever died in the grain. Which is worse.

steps.where: the grain lofts of Three Wheels

quests.done: Lovely. Now I just have to find out what died.

quests.name: The Tinker's Tools
quests.offer: My tools went flying when the cart went over. Brigands picked them up. Brigands can't even use a solder iron.
quests.done: My good pliers! I'll mend anything you like. Within reason. Not your love life.

quests.name: Keep Watch
quests.offer: My sentries keep seeing hounds circling the keep at night. My sentries also keep seeing their own feet. Go look.
quests.done: So they were real. I owe the sentries an apology. I won't give one.

quests.name: Below Three Wheels
quests.offer: A millrace collapsed into old mine workings. Something came out. Go in and finish the job the collapse started.

steps.text: Defeat what waits at the bottom

quests.done: The millrace is ours again. Mostly ours. A bit shared with the bats.

quests.name: The Vale's Worst Neighbour
quests.offer: There's one beast every farmer in the vale curses by name. Make the name a memory.
quests.done: We'll drink to you at harvest. We'll drink to anything at harvest, but mainly you.
